title: The w-value: Market Implementation and gamma-Core Stability in Pollution-Control Games
abstract: arXiv:2502.16800v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel solution concept, called the w-value, for cooperative pollution-control games. The w-value is axiomatically founded on three principles: Pareto Optimality (PO), Market Equilibrium (ME), and Fiscal Balance (FB), which together yield an efficient and implementable welfare distribution. We establish its existence and uniqueness under standard concavity and convexity assumptions, and provide a market mechanism that implements it through price constraints and an initial permit allocation. A key theoretical advantage is its strong stability: the w-value belongs to the gamma-core, which makes it resistant to coalitional deviations. Moreover, the w-value can be obtained through a simple step-by-step procedure, which facilitates its application to complex real-world problems. translated_title: w-值：污染控制博弈中的市场实施与γ-核稳定性
translated_abstract: 本文为合作污染控制博弈提出了一种新颖的解概念，称为w-值（the w-value）。w-值建立在三个公理化原则之上：帕累托最优（PO）、市场均衡（ME）和财政平衡（FB），这三个原则共同产生了一种高效且可实施的福利分配方案。我们在标准的凹性和凸性假设下证明了w-值的存在性和唯一性，并提供了一种通过价格约束和初始许可证分配来实现它的市场机制。其关键理论优势在于强稳定性：w-值属于γ-核（gamma-core），这使其能够抵御联盟的偏离。此外，w-值可以通过简单的逐步计算程序求得，这便于其应用于复杂的现实问题。数值示例展示了逐步计算的过程，并以数值方式验证了其γ-核成员资格。
tldr: 本文提出了污染控制合作博弈中基于帕累托最优、市场均衡和财政平衡三原则的w-值解概念，证明其存在唯一性、可通过市场机制实施、属于γ-核具有强稳定性，并能通过简单的逐步程序计算求得。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the w-value, a novel solution concept for cooperative pollution-control games founded on Pareto Optimality, Market Equilibrium, and Fiscal Balance, and establishes its existence, uniqueness, market implementability, gamma-core stability, and computability via a simple step-by-step procedure.
